# hostaria_os (Data Source)

Un OS du catalogue, par `id` ou `slug` (`GET /v1/os`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostaria_os" "ubuntu" {
  slug = "ubuntu-24-04"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `family` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `os` (String)
- `version` (String)
